description: This source file is a shell script designed for testing Git push options behavior. It contains setup functions, test cases, and logic for verifying push options handling in various scenarios, including local repositories, submodules, and HTTP-based repositories.

methods.name: mk_repo_pair
methods.description: Creates and sets up a pair of repositories named 'upstream' and 'workbench' with configured hooks for push options.

methods.name: test_refs
methods.description: Compares references between repositories to verify they are identical.

methods.name: mk_http_pair
methods.description: Sets up an HTTP server repository with dummy push options support, cloning from local repositories.
